import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog
import subprocess

def adjust_playback_speed(video_file, speed):
    # Use FFmpeg to adjust the playback speed of the video
    command = f"ffmpeg -i {video_file} -vf aresample=async=1 -af aresample=async=1 -ar {speed} output.mp4"
    subprocess.run(command, shell=True)

def start_adjustment():
    video_file = entry.get()
    speed = float(speed_entry.get())
    adjust_playback_speed(video_file, speed)

root = tk.Tk()
root.title("Video Speed Adjuster")

label = tk.Label(root, text="Video file path:")
label.pack()
entry = tk.Entry(root)
entry.pack()

label = tk.Label(root, text="Playback speed:")
label.pack()
speed_entry = tk.Entry(root)
speed_entry.pack()

button = tk.Button(root, text="Start", command=start_adjustment)
button.pack()

button = tk.Button(root, text="Select video file", command=lambda: entry.insert(0, filedialog.askopenfilename()))
button.pack()

root.mainloop()
```

This code creates a simple GUI that allows users to input the desired playback speed and select the video file. It then uses the FFmpeg library to adjust the playback speed of the video and write the modified video to a new file.
